_source: carbon-tracker workspace: research/offset-methodology-proposal-2026-08.md (2026-08-08, Tier 1 'price honesty' adopted) over research/carbon-offset-landscape-2026-08.md (2026-08-06, incl. second-pass verification addendum) and research/offset-cost-methodology-evidence-2026-08.md. Decision rule: ex-post only — a dollar buys carbon already verifiably removed or destroyed, never a promise.
_tier: TIER 1 ONLY: the removal price is corrected to what the linked vendor actually charges, and nothing else changes. The proposal's Tier 2 multipliers were considered and NOT adopted — there is no uncertainty factor, no durability factor, and embodied CO2e does NOT enter the settlement target. Embodied stays reported on its own line exactly as before, and the cost line stays proportional to the tonnes balance. If a later pass adopts those factors they belong here as their own constants with their own sources, never folded into this price.
_removal: Retail, ex-post biochar CORCs. Remove Carbon Today — the vendor this tool links to below — sells 1 tonne of carbon removal at EUR 198 with Puro registry retirement proof, priced as its average CORC acquisition cost plus a 10% operating margin (fetched 2026-08-08). At the ledger's own dated FX constant (ECB 0.8729 EUR/USD, data/prices.json): 198 / 0.8729 = 226.83, stored as 227. This deliberately replaces the previous 160, which was the Nasdaq CORCCHAR wholesale index level: an index is what institutions clear at, not a price this user can transact. Cross-check: the CDR.fyi/OPIS May 2026 survey puts biochar spot and institutional quotes at 200-400 USD/t with supplier breakeven-plus-margin around 187 USD/t, so 160 sat below the supplier ask for the tool's own recommended action. FX-SENSITIVE: this figure moves with both the CORC market and the euro, so refresh it with the ECB rate — quarterly suggested, per MAINTENANCE.md's dated-constant discipline. Only REMOVAL counts against the headline balance.
_prevention: Tradewater refrigerant/methane destruction, ~$15/t retail checkout, completed destruction (ex-post; cleanest additionality of the cheap tier). Unchanged by the 2026-08-08 price pass. Watch item carried forward from research/charity-carbon-ranking-2026-08.md: the $15/t could not be independently confirmed against comparables (Recoolit pilot credits ~$75/t), so verify at next purchase. Prevention is avoidance leverage, NOT removal — reported on its own line, never in the headline balance.
_water: Bonneville Environmental Foundation Water Restoration Certificate: 1 WRC = 1,000 US gallons returned to a stressed stream, third-party reviewed (NFWF) and registered on S&P Global Markit. $4.00/WRC at BEF's own store (fetched 2026-08-08). Terrapass resells the same instrument at roughly $2.00/WRC — a 2x spread inside a single-issuer market, which is what a thin market looks like in price form. Both ends are stored so the page can show the spread rather than a single tidy number. The HIGHER, first-party price is the one used for the figure deliberately: quoting the cheaper reseller would understate what the gesture costs at its source, and the spread itself is disclosed on the page. This funds RESTORATION — returning flow to a stressed stream — and is NOT an offset of the water this account used: water is basin-local and not fungible, so a gallon restored in one watershed does not repay a gallon drawn in another. It settles nothing and never touches the carbon balance.
